hooks.command: f=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$f" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'prisma[^&|;]*\b(db push|migrate reset)\b'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: prisma db push / migrate reset bypasses versioned migrations and can wipe data. Use prisma migrate dev locally or migrate deploy in prod — see docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md (Migrations, versioning, and rollback)."}}'; fi

f=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$f" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]/])vercel(@[^[:space:]]*)?[[:space:]]+(deploy|dev|whoami|link|logs|inspect|promote|rollback|--prod)' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -q -- '--token'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: bare vercel command. The global Vercel CLI login is shared and usually wrong for this project. Deploy via git push to origin main, or use an account-scoped token per the parent CLAUDE.md deployment rule."}}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for bare vercel CLI commands...

hooks.command: f=$(cat); p=$(echo "$f" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if echo "$p" | grep -q 'packages/database/prisma/migrations/'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: migration files are append-only once committed. Generate a new migration with prisma migrate dev instead of hand-editing an existing one — see docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md (Migrations, versioning, and rollback)."}}'; fi

f=$(cat); p=$(echo "$f" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$p" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx --no-install eslint --fix "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; npx --no-install prettier --write "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; *.json|*.md|*.css) npx --no-install prettier --write "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; true
